name: Valley Path, Outside Inn
desc1: This narrow path has long since been reclaimed by long grasses and
desc2: plants, so much so that it is difficult to follow. The ground is hard
desc3: earth, with a not unpleasant smell that fills the air. The door to the
desc4: inn stands open here, inviting anyone to enter, a sign hanging over
desc5: the door showing a Lion and a Lamb. To the south, a small trail leads
desc6: off, accompanied by the unmistakeable marks of wagon wheels.
